thread:
customer-ops: Seeing toolcall args getting truncated when a streaming connection resumes. Customer reported missing trailing braces in the tool args JSON. Request ID: req_0b3f. Example from logs: `... "params": {"id": 123, "user": "alice", "session": "abc` (no closing "`/`})
support-jay: Thanks — can you paste the raw SSE frames and the exact curl or client steps you used to repro?
customer-ops: Repro command we used (simplified):
```bash
curl -N -H "Accept: text/event-stream" \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \n  "https://api.redwood.example/v1/stream?model=tool-caller"
```
Then we simulated a network hiccup (SIGINT) and reconnected. Raw frames around the truncation:
```
event: message\ndata: {"type":"tool_call","tool":"process","params":{"id":123,"user":"alice","session":"abc\n```
(on reconnect we get a resumed frame chunk starting `def"}}` missing — looks like the tail never arrived to the client)
chris: This looks like a chunk boundary split. If the proxy or LB splits a chunk mid-UTF8/JSON and the client reconnects, the assembled stream can be missing trailing bytes. Are you running nginx in front of the runtime?
customer-ops: yes nginx 1.22 in a VM, haproxy before that for external LB. It reproduces more when keepalive is high and the client reconnect is ~6–10s after interruption.
maria: Two quick hypotheses: 1) proxy buffering or request buffering is trimming/splitting SSE payloads and not forwarding the last partial chunk on resume; 2) client-side reconnection logic isn't requesting any missing bytes and we don't have an explicit integrity marker.
support-jay: Customer workaround: append an extra newline after JSON so the JSON end falls in a previous frame. Ugly but reduced incidents.
sre-lucas: I'll pull nginx logs for req_0b3f and check `upstream_response_time` and `proxy_*` settings. Suspect `proxy_buffering` + `proxy_busy_buffers_size` interplay. Trying local tweak first:
```nginx
proxy_request_buffering off;
proxy_buffering off;
proxy_buffers 8 16k;
proxy_busy_buffers_size 64k;
```
maria: For a durable fix we should: (A) add a tiny framing header (length prefix) for toolcall args in the stream so clients can detect incomplete frames, (B) add an integ test that explicitly cuts streams mid-json and validates reassembly, (C) document recommended nginx/haproxy settings.
customer-ops: :thumbsup: adding a length prefix on top of SSE was easy on their side and it prevented silent truncation. We'll include full logs in the ticket.
support-jay: Filed escalation E-4112 with eng-runtime + SRE. Action items: SRE to propose nginx config + run regression on staging, Eng-runtime to add an automated mid-chunk reassembly test and consider length-prefixed tool args. cc: @maria @sre-lucas
